objective: Make model-scoped persistent decode state explicit in the shared Rust MegaKernel so per-model CPU/GPU/ANE work cannot misclassify prefix replay as repeated decode.

implementation.continuation_rule: advance position only after state update and accepted token; retain all state regions across steps

model_scope.flash_next: Recognized state-update and SDPA organs produce recurrent and KV regions in its model card.
model_scope.kimi_p0: Its model card receives only the state regions implied by its exact recognized organs; no Flash result transfers automatically.

verification.native_protocol: Built hawking-gravityd emitted exactly runtime.route_cache, linear_attention_state.recurrent, and full_attention_sdpa.kv for the Flash model-scoped organ request; linear attention was verified not to receive a false KV region.
verification.python: python3 -m pytest -q hcli/test_daemon_delegation_supervisor.py hcli/test_delegate.py hcli/tests/test_serve_openai_surface.py hcli/test_hawkingd_daemon_name.py hcli/test_processes.py hcli/test_ane_provider.py hcli/test_architecture.py
verification.syntax_and_diff: python3 -m py_compile hcli/physical_graph.py hcli/ane_provider.py && git diff --check

claim_boundary: This is a deterministic plan/state-lifecycle contract. It does not allocate a GPU or ANE buffer, execute Flash or KIMI, establish source parity, measure repeated decode, report TPS, or promote any backend.
